functions.name: basis.has_role
functions.sql:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION basis.has_role(role_id text)
      RETURNS boolean
      LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public, basis, pg_temp AS $$
        SELECT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM "UserRole" ur
          WHERE ur."role.id" = role_id
            AND ur."user.id" = nullif(current_setting('actor.id', true), '')
        )
      $$;

functions.body:
SELECT u."id"
        FROM "User" u
        WHERE u."id" = candidate
          AND EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM "ExternalIdentity" e
            WHERE e."user.id" = u."id" AND e."revoked" = false
          )
functions.name: basis.resolve_identity
functions.sql:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION basis.resolve_identity(candidate text)
      RETURNS text
      LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public, basis, pg_temp AS $$
        SELECT u."id"
        FROM "User" u
        WHERE u."id" = candidate
          AND EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM "ExternalIdentity" e
            WHERE e."user.id" = u."id" AND e."revoked" = false
          )
      $$;

tables.name: Entity
tables.sql:
create table "Entity" (
"id" text primary key,
"name" text not null,
"entity" text not null,
"lastUpdatedBy.id" text,
"lastUpdatedAt" timestamptz,
constraint "Entity_id_format_check" check (("id" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$' or case
    when "id" ~ '^(0|-?[1-9][0-9]*)$' and length("id") <= 20
      then "id"::numeric between -9223372036854775808 and 9223372036854775807
    else false
  end)),
constraint "Entity_entity_check" check ("entity" in ('User', 'Role', 'ExternalIdentity', 'Note'))
)
